What each tool can do

Choose the right output, with the important boundaries explained before you start.

ToolCurrent boundary
Office conversionsText-oriented, not layout-preserving. Legacy exports use an HTML .doc wrapper and safe CSV. New DOCX exports selectable text; XLSX exports extracted rows; PPTX exports page images. DOC/PPT legacy inputs and full layout fidelity are unsupported.
CompressionRaster compression loses text selection, forms and accessibility information. Target size is best effort. Lossless PDF compression preserves page content but may not reduce size.
OCREnglish only; recognition needs review. Invisible text is not precisely positioned. OCR language models may be downloaded from the Tesseract model host.
SignatureTyped or drawn visual mark, not certificate-based signing, identity verification, or signature requests.
EditorAdds text, shapes, image watermarks and drawn ink; existing PDF text is not editable. Standard fonts have limited language coverage.
ScannerPhoto capture/import and near-white trimming; no perspective correction.
Privacy InspectorRead-only structural checks, not a security audit or secure-erasure guarantee. Sanitized sharing downloads are disabled pending verification.
Clear info fieldsClears selected standard document-info fields only. It is not hidden-data removal.
SanitizationVerified secure sanitization is unavailable and produces no PDF download.
RedactionExperimental raster output; page and region are validated before download. Verify visual result and extracted text independently.
Header removalWhite overlays leave text recoverable. Not redaction.
Ask PDF / summaryAsk PDF and Smart summary use keyword retrieval / sentence ranking. AI Summarizer uses the browser Summarizer API when supported, with an optional browser-managed model download; English only.
RepairLegacy Repair resaves parseable files. Recover damaged PDF uses local qpdf recovery; missing or severely corrupt content cannot be recreated.
TranslationBrowser-dependent Translator API; English source and TXT output. Browser-managed language models may be downloaded or used.
PDF/AValidated archival PDF/A conversion is unavailable.
FormsManual field creation and filling are supported. Automatic field detection is unavailable.
HTML conversionLocal HTML text only. Remote webpage URLs are not fetched.
ComparisonText comparison and side-by-side visual previews; no exhaustive graphical diff.
File limits100 MB per file beta processing limit; device memory can impose lower limits.

Changes may invalidate digital signatures. Keep originals. Cancellation reloads the tab and clears selected files; it is not resumable.
